title: Loop fuel source machine
statement: Given finite Turing machines $B$ and $F$ over the Boolean alphabet, there is a multi-tape machine with $B.k+1+(1+F.k)$ work tapes and the state set of $F$. Its initial state is that of $F$, and its transition uses the transition of $F$ on the same state and input symbol, with the symbols on the final $F.k$ work tapes as its work-tape input; the action is extended to account for the additional work tapes.
caveat: The supplied statement uses an undefined helper for extending the action, so the behavior of the added tapes cannot be specified more precisely from the given material.
